subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.prompt:
Why do many flowers have bright petals and sweet nectar?
A) To scare away animals
B) To attract pollinators
C) To make the plant taller
D) To block sunlight

steps: Bright petals and nectar attract pollinators that spread pollen.

items.prompt:
A bird's courtship dance is an example of a behavior that helps with:
A) Digestion
B) Reproduction
C) Breathing
D) Growing taller

steps: Courtship displays attract mates and aid reproduction.

items.prompt:
A structure or behavior that increases the chance of surviving and reproducing is called a(n):
A) Organ
B) Adaptation
C) Tissue
D) Nucleus

Seeds with tiny hooks that stick to fur help the plant by:
A) Making food
B) Spreading seeds to new places
C) Attracting pollinators
D) Storing water
items.answer: B) Spreading seeds to new places

steps: Hooked seeds are carried by animals to new locations, spreading offspring.

items.prompt:
Which animal behavior most directly increases the survival of offspring?
A) Sleeping
B) Protecting the young
C) Shedding fur
D) Drinking water

steps: Protecting young raises the chance offspring survive to reproduce.

items.prompt:
A plant surrounds its seeds with sweet fruit. The most likely benefit is that:
A) The fruit makes the plant grow faster
B) Animals eat the fruit and spread the seeds
C) The fruit attracts sunlight
D) The seeds cannot be eaten
items.answer: B) Animals eat the fruit and spread the seeds

steps: Animals eat the fruit and disperse the seeds to new places.

items.prompt:
Why do reproductive adaptations tend to become more common in a population over time?
A) They are passed to more offspring because those organisms reproduce more successfully
B) They disappear quickly
C) They prevent reproduction
D) They are random and never inherited
items.answer: A) They are passed to more offspring because those organisms reproduce more successfully

steps: Traits that raise reproductive success are passed on to more offspring each generation.

items.prompt:
A gardener removes all the colorful flowers from a plant before it blooms. What is the most likely effect on reproduction?
A) More seeds will form
B) Fewer pollinators will visit, so fewer seeds will form
C) The plant will reproduce faster
D) Nothing will change
items.answer: B) Fewer pollinators will visit, so fewer seeds will form

steps: Without colorful flowers, fewer pollinators visit, reducing pollination and seed production.
